<td class="text">Segment Information<div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Company operates and presents financial information as </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">one</span><span style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> operating and reportable segment as the MSG Rangers Corp. businesses were operated as part of the single segment of MSG Knicks and were not separately evaluated for the periods presented in the combined financial statements. MSG Knicks' Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer was the CODM for the periods presented. As a single segment entity, combined net income (loss) is used to assess financial performance, allocate resources, and make key operating decisions, such as entering into significant contracts, setting strategic objectives for the Company, and approving annual operating budgets, including approving significant investments in team personnel, and other key executive leadership positions. The CODM does not review segment assets at a different asset level or category than those disclosed in the accompanying combined balance sheets.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span See Note 13 for further details related to the Arena License Agreement.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:18pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">(e)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:10.8pt">Team operating expenses primarily consist of team personnel compensation (net of escrow), expenses associated with day-to-day team operations, including for travel, player insurance, and operating costs of the Company&#8217;s training center in Greenburgh, NY, net of allocations to MSG Knicks. See Note 13 for further details related to allocations to MSG Knicks.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt;padding-left:18pt;text-indent:-18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">(f)</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:11.88pt">Other segment items primarily consist of net provisions for league revenue sharing expense (excluding playoffs), league assessments, playoff related expenses, cost of goods sold and commission expense related to merchandise revenues, and share-based compensation expense.</span></div><span></span>
